description: Match bank statement lines to ledger (cash book) lines for a bank reconciliation. Send the bank lines and the ledger lines (date and amount; money in positive, money out negative), a date window in days, and optionally the bank statement ending balance and the ledger ending balance. Get back the matched pairs, the lines left unmatched on each side (deposits in transit and outstanding payments on the ledger side; bank credits and charges not yet recorded on the bank side), the net difference between the two lists, and, with both balances, the adjusted bank and ledger balances and any difference still unexplained. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/bank-reconciliation-match). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.

bank.description: Bank statement lines (up to 200; an empty list if none).

amount.description: Amount as the account sees it: money in (deposits, receipts) positive, money out (checks, payments, fees) negative. Not 0.

ref.description: Optional reference (a check number or memo, up to 6 digits in a row; your own text, echoed).

bank_ending_balance.description: Optional: ending balance on the bank statement (send with ledger_ending_balance).

date_window_days.description: Largest gap in days between a bank line and its ledger line (default 3).

label.description: Optional label for the reconciliation (your own text, echoed; not an account number).

ledger.description: Ledger (cash book) lines for the same account (up to 200; an empty list if none).

amount.description: Amount as the account sees it: money in (deposits, receipts) positive, money out (checks, payments, fees) negative. Not 0.

ref.description: Optional reference (a check number or memo, up to 6 digits in a row; your own text, echoed).

ledger_ending_balance.description: Optional: ending balance of the cash account in the ledger on the same date (send with bank_ending_balance).
